9. SURFACE TRANSPORTATION STATUS UPDATE MESSAGE
LAYOUT

GENERAL STATUS ANSWER (STA) MESSAGE
1. STANDARD MESSAGE IDENTIFIER = STA
2. MESSAGE FUNCTION
To provide the various status information requested by a General Status Request
(STR) message which includes:
• the latest status for a nominated consignment(s);
• all the statuses attained (history) for a nominated consignment;
• the latest status for all consignments expected to depart from a particular station
to a specific destination on a specific date and belonging to the requesting party.

3. MESSAGE APPLICATION
Computer-to-Computer/Computer-to-Manual/Manual-to-Manual.

4. MESSAGE EXCHANGE PARTIES
From
(Computer):
From (Manual):

To (Computer):

To (Manual)

the airline’s computer, warehouse operator, or handling
agent replying to the request for status information.
the airline, warehouse operator, or handling agent to
which the General Status Request (STR) was
addressed.
the access address of the cargo computer system from
which the General Status Request (STR) was sent, e.g.
forwarder.
the office, e.g. freight forwarder, who initialised the
request.

5. MESSAGE USE
—

6. MESSAGE EXAMPLES

a particular station for a specific destination indicating one consignment manifested on
a specific flight and another consignment delivered to a consignee or his agent.

9. GENERAL STATUS ANSWER MESSAGE LAYOUT

SURFACE TRANSPORTATION MOVEMENT (STM) MESSAGE
1. STANDARD MESSAGE IDENTIFIER = STM
2. MESSAGE FUNCTION
To record Road Feeder Service (RFS) movements including:
• scheduled, estimated, actual departures and delayed departures;
• arrivals;
• indefinite delayed departures;
• supplementary information.

3. MESSAGE APPLICATION
Computer-to-Computer, Computer-to-Manual, Manual-to-Computer, Manual-toManual.

4. MESSAGE EXCHANGE PARTIES
From: the carrier’s control office, local office, the RFS provider, or other
interested parties, e.g. Cargo Community System.
To:
the carrier’s control office, downline station, RFS provider or other
interested parties, e.g. Cargo Community System.

5. MESSAGE USE
The STM message is sent whenever a RFS movement or planned movement
needs to be recorded, including at truck departure, arrival expected departure or
when further information is known.

9. SURFACE TRANSPORTATION MOVEMENT MESSAGE LAYOUT

GENERAL STATUS REQUEST (STR) MESSAGE
1. STANDARD MESSAGE IDENTIFIER = STR
2. MESSAGE FUNCTION
To request various status information concerning consignments. This information
includes:
• the latest status for a nominated consignment(s);
• all the statuses attained (history) for a nominated consignment;
• the latest status for all consignments expected to depart from a particular station
to a specific destination on a specific date and belonging to the requesting party.

3. MESSAGE APPLICATION
Computer-to-Computer/Computer-to-Manual.

4. MESSAGE EXCHANGE PARTIES
From
(Computer):
To (Computer):

To (Manual):

the party, e.g. forwarder, requesting the consignment
status information.
the access address of the airline’s computer, warehouse
operator, or handling agent controlling the movement of
the consignments.
the station or transshipment point of the airline,
warehouse operator or handling agent.

5. MESSAGE USE
—

Meaning

Abbr Code

Divided Consignment

Multi-Shipments

M

Part Consignment

P

Split Consignment

Total Consignment

T

703

For the purpose of these Codes:
Total Consignment = total number of pieces of
complete shipment.
Part Consignment = those pieces less than the
total consignment carried on one flight.
Split Consignment = those pieces of a total
consignment carried in more than one ULD(s)
and/or bulk on the same flight.
Divided Consignment = those pieces of a part
consignment in more than one ULD(s) and/or
bulk on the same flight.
Multi-Shipments = those pieces less than the
total consignment carried on more than one
flight.

Meaning

density

It should be noted that this information should
serve only as a guideline and the density of
certain commodities may be different and related
to the country of origin of the goods.
In cases where commodity is not adequately
defined, density group 6 must be used.

accepts any version, extracting the data required. The version numbers indicated above
therefore relate only to outbound messages.FWB/15, FHL/4 and FFM/8 are recommended

Note

Incoming versions accepted by Sirius : This has been set to highest possible, as system will
accept any lower versions sent.
Outgoing versions sent by Sirius: This has been set according to today's versions and
the knowledge of what most receivers accepts. Please note that same version will be sent to
all receivers of cargo IMP messages. Only FFR and FFA can be change to other version per
message receiver.
